description: This is a Java source file defining the ObjectTracker class used for tracking objects in an Android application as part of TensorFlow's demo package. The class interfaces with native code to perform object tracking across video frames, maintains tracked objects, and provides debugging and visualization functionalities.

classes.name: ObjectTracker
classes.description: Main class for tracking objects across frames. Manages native object tracker, tracked objects, and visualization.

classes.name: ObjectTracker.Keypoint
classes.description: Represents keypoint information used for calculating FrameChange deltas.

classes.name: ObjectTracker.PointChange
classes.description: Represents a change between two keypoints, including delta and score.

classes.name: ObjectTracker.FrameChange
classes.description: Records timestamped frame translation deltas for optical flow calculation.

classes.name: ObjectTracker.TrackedObject
classes.description: Represents an individual object being tracked, encapsulating position, visibility, and native tracking handle.

classes.name: ObjectTracker.TimestampedDeltas
classes.description: Helper class to record deltas with associated timestamps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor to obtain the ObjectTracker instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the native tracker with scaled dimensions.

methods.name: drawOverlay
methods.description: Draws overlay elements onto the GL10 surface for debugging visualization.

methods.name: nextFrame
methods.description: Processes a new frame, updates tracking, and records deltas.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases native resources and resets the singleton.

methods.name: trackObject
methods.description: Creates a new tracked object given its initial position and frame data.
